policy: Curated publisher/manufacturer evidence and DOI metadata, not full-text redistribution or automated novelty proof. Exact-pair evidence is distinct from family/platform evidence.

references.title: Expanding the Library of Ions for Moisture-Swing Carbon Capture
references.claim: Pyrophosphate-loaded IRA900 was studied before this project. Ranking depends on normalization: pyrophosphate led by ion/charge, while dibasic phosphate and tribasic phosphate had different strength/kinetics criteria. Do not claim these ions as novel.
references.note: Publisher abstract and 2025 Wang paper cross-reference.

references.title: Investigation of Moisture Swing Adsorbents for Direct Air Capture by Dynamic Breakthrough Studies
references.claim: Dynamic breakthrough experiments on IRA900-C show humidity-dependent working capacity and mass transfer/kinetics; reports prior Hegarty pyrophosphate findings.
references.note: Do not attribute pyrophosphate measurements to this paper.

references.title: Structure-Property Relationships for Moisture-Swing Direct Air Capture
references.claim: Across ten commercial resins, site type, counterion and pore connectivity interact. Type I showed stronger phosphate and Type II stronger carbonate swing under studied conditions; kinetics and architecture matter.
references.note: Cannot transfer family-wide result to an unmeasured exact resin/counterion pair.

references.title: CO2 Sorption in Moisture Swing Anion Exchange Resins for Direct Air Capture: Experimental Isotherm Determination and Modeling
references.claim: Experimental isotherms and modelling on IRA900 support measuring capacity across humidity, temperature and CO2 partial pressure.

references.title: Active Learning-Guided Optimization of Moisture Swing Adsorption for Direct Air Capture
references.claim: 290 data points, 201 distinct experimental conditions across 20 resins, incorporating active learning and experimental validation of selected pairs. This is prior methodology, not our novel discovery.
references.note: The publisher article is CC BY 4.0, but the separate PYU-pub/MSA-ML code/data repository does not declare a repository license in GitHub metadata or its root. Attribution alone is not a confirmed blanket permission for commercial redistribution. Seek owner confirmation/clear license and pin data revision.

references.title: Moisture Swing Ion-Exchange Resin-PO4 Sorbent for Reversible CO2 Capture from Ambient Air
references.claim: Phosphate moisture-swing concept was already investigated. Does not by itself validate every modern resin formulation.

references.title: AmberLite IRA900 Cl product data sheet
references.claim: Product manufacturer documents macroporous Type I strong-base anion-exchange resin. Product datasheet does not experimentally establish an exchanged-ion moisture-swing performance.

references.title: D201 resin data sheet
references.claim: Historic datasheet shows commercial resin family only. D201 is not automatically equivalent to IRA900 or its atomistic fragment.
